sources: Hits, frames, keys and events: rmxlinux Json/SkillData chr_0003_endminf_* (game 1.6) as compiled by efsim kit-draft, and Json/BuffData buff_common_originum_frozen, buff_chr_0003_endminf_*; values SkillPatchTable. Batch-2 report docs/kit-batches/batch-2/chr_0003_endminf.md (mechanics table, kit plan, section Kit).

One kit for both playable IDs: chr_0002_endminm (male) has the same SkillPatchTable values, hit frames, masks and keys (all 11 skill pairs compared); its finisher is chr_0002_endminm_power_attack (the female's power_attack2); its windows and durationFrame are read from its own SkillData. BuffData is shared by both (buff_chr_0003_endminf_*). chr_9000_endmin, the virtual character (GlobalConst endminVirtualCharId), holds the talents and potentials: the loader gives both IDs its talent nodes (chr_9000_endmin_talent_*: atk_up 0.15 / 0.30 and duration 15 for talent 1; dmg 0.10 / 0.20 for talent 2).

Talent indices: 0 is Essence Disintegration (buff_chr_0003_endminf_talent_1: ATK up after a consumption), 1 is Realspace Stasis (buff_chr_0003_endminf_talent_0: Physical DMG taken on sealed enemies), in CharGrowthTable order.

Stagger (poise): damage units with damageAttributeType 1 (the skills' poise keys), hand-written. Finisher factors 0.1 / 0.9: BreakingAttackCalculation multiplier of its two DamageActions (frames 9 and 27).
Log keys: fixtures/pending/zmdlogs-7e19489ae503.json logs the female combo under chr_0002_endminm_combo_skill and the crystal hits under buff_common_originum_frozen.

buffs.label: Originium Crystals (combo skill; talent 2 Realspace Stasis: Physical DMG taken)
buffs.note: Combo frame 23 CreateBuff buff_common_originum_frozen between its two DamageActions (duration = the combo's `duration`, 4 / 4.5 / 5 s at L1-9 / 10-11 / 12; max 1, stackingType 2; atk_scale_trigger and originum_ult_break_scale assigned from the combo). Talent 2 is buff_chr_0003_endminf_talent_0, an aura on the team: DamageScaleProcessor side 1 (defender) NormalCalcZone +dmg on physical hits (CheckDamageType 0) while the target carries buff_common_originum_frozen; written on the crystals so it lasts exactly as long. The seal on enemies with super armor below 20 (buff_common_originum_frozen_inner, time dilation 0) isn't modelled: no super armor in EnemyData, bosses unaffected (report G6, deferred).

buffs.label: Essence Disintegration (talent 1): ATK up
buffs.note: "When the Originium Crystals attached to the enemy are consumed, the Endministrator gains ATK +{atk_up} for {duration}s. This effect cannot stack." Created by every ignite handler of buff_common_originum_frozen (stackingType 2, max 1: a new one refreshes it). Logged as 0.30 at talent level 2 in 7e19.

buffs.label: Reflection of Authority (P2): half of talent 1's ATK for the other operators
buffs.note: P2: the other operators get `ratio` (0.5) of talent 1's ATK for the same duration, in the same ignite handlers. Logged as 0.15 on three teammates in 7e19.

triggers.note: COMBO TRIGGER: When another operator in the team deals DMG with combo skills.

buff_common_originum_frozen igniteEventAction igniteType 1: DamageAction atk_scale_trigger (the combo's, mask 12288: combo kind; damage source the Endministrator), then talent 1 on her and P2's half on the teammates, then finishAfterIgnited. `now`: the crystal hit lands inside the handler and still sees the crystals (talent 2). buff_physical_airborne, _knockdown and _do_crushed run their own DamageAction before their IgniteAction, so the status hit sees the crystals too: after damage here (fixtures/pending/zmdlogs-7e19489ae503.json t=33734: the Crush hit 413,543 and the crystal hit both carry talent 2's +0.2; the battle skill hit, whose DamageAction comes after the CrushAction, doesn't). Interim: the engine computes a status hit's damage after its skill hit's, so the skill hit that applied the status sees the crystals too, and talent 1 comes only after both (in the game the skill hit has talent 1 and not talent 2: about even); report gap K1.

igniteType 1 from buff_physical_do_fracture, whose IgniteAction comes before its DamageAction: Breach's hit and the skill hit that applied it no longer see the crystals, and talent 1's ATK acts on both (before damage). 7e19 t=14984 (a teammate's Breach): the crystal hit has talent 2 and neither talent 1 nor Breach's Physical DMG taken.

igniteType 7: buff_physical_no_guard buffEvent 7 IgniteAction, on every Vulnerable stack added (its >= 2 check guards only Shatter's handler). A Crush or Breach on an enemy without Vulnerable only adds a stack, so it consumes the crystals through this trigger.

igniteType 6 (the ultimate's IgniteAction at frame 50, after its break hit): talent 1, P2, P3's usp 15 ("After consuming Originium Crystals, the Endministrator gains {usp} Ultimate Energy. This effect does not benefit from other bonuses.": ignoreUspGainScalar, only in this handler), then the crystals end. One frame after the hits, so all three see the crystals and none gets talent 1's ATK.

P1 Final Awakening, "Consuming Originium Crystals returns {atb_return} SP": normal_skill frame 11 ChannelingAction, with the P1 buff and the target sealed and not has_returned, ObtainCostAction costType 1 atb_return (50), atbSourceType 3 (returned SP: no ultimate energy when spent), once per cast; before the hit's Crush consumes the crystals.

P5 (its description is ??? in every language): normal_skill frames 11-14 and ultimate 50-53 create potential5_trigger (0.1 s) once when they hit; buff_chr_0003_endminf_potential5 abilityEvent 9 on it runs SetSkillCdAtOnce on both combo IDs by cd_minus (2 s, functionType 0: a running cooldown is cut).

hits.note: "As the controlled operator, Final Strike also deals {poise} Stagger" (mask 2097280); its atb (20) is the skill's SP.

"Deals Physical DMG and applies Crush": ChannelingAction at frame 11, one hit per target (maxCountPerTarget 1); its CrushAction runs before the DamageAction. The data's two branches (with P1 on a sealed target, without) deal the same hit; P1's SP is the p1_sp trigger.

The second DamageAction at frame 23 (the first names atk_scale without useBlackboardKey: a literal 0, left out; the log has one combo hit per cast). The crystals are created between the two, so talent 2 counts for this hit. Logged under chr_0002_endminm_combo_skill for the female too (7e19).
"deals one more hit" on a sealed enemy: ForEach target with buff_common_originum_frozen → DamageAction originum_ult_break_scale (mask 512), then IgniteAction 6.

dataOverride.scale: Batch 2, the Endministrator (both IDs: chr_0002_endminm is the kit's variant). (The combo's first DamageAction at 23, a literal-0 scale, is left out by the compiler since batch 4's D8, as by the kit.) The ultimate's IgniteAction 6 runs buff_common_originum_frozen's own DamageAction (atk_scale_trigger from the combo), which the compiler doesn't follow (an ignite handler of a buff on the target); the kit's third hit on sealed targets.

hits.note: igniteType 6 also runs the crystals' own DamageAction: atk_scale_trigger (the combo's level) with mask 4608 (ultimate kind). The description names only one extra hit: in-game test proposed in the report (E1).
